items.text: Moldova says attackers pulled data on about 750,000 people from state systems over Oct 19-23, and suspects AI helped them. The president has called the security council.
Top House Democrats ask OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXSI to report AI safety incidents to Congress within 48 hours. A request, not a law; full accounting due Nov 11.
items.source_label: House Energy and Commerce Democrats, Oct 28

items.text: Canada's five biggest banks are blocking or limiting customers' personal AI agents from online banking.
Correction: Georgia says Anthropic confirmed its AI did not bypass a paywall; the vote-count data was on the state's free public Data Hub.
